title: CrisisParams
description: Parameters governing the endogenous banking crisis channel. SPEC-CRISIS-1.

crisis_base.description: Base crisis probability at the threshold (before slope contribution).

crisis_slope.description: Slope: additional probability per unit of fragility above crisis_threshold.

crisis_threshold.description: Fragility level at which crisis probability begins to rise above crisis_base.

severity.description: Base unemployment increase from a crisis hit (before severityReduction and jitter).

inflation_drop.description: Absolute drop in inflation when a crisis hits.

credibility_drop.description: Points of credibility lost when a crisis hits.

output_gap_drop.description: Absolute drop in output_gap when a crisis hits.

post_crisis_fragility.description: bank_fragility is reset to this value after a crisis (the cleansing effect).

severity_jitter.description: Std deviation of the stochastic jitter added to the unemployment impact (drawn from seeded rng).

cooldown_months.description: Months of cooldown after a crisis during which another crisis cannot occur.

initial_bank_fragility.description: Default value for state.vars.bank_fragility when absent from state (SPEC-PROD-1 pattern).

initial_output_gap.description: Default value for state.vars.output_gap when absent from state (SPEC-PROD-1 pattern).
